threat_event: Attacker uses a commissioning engineer's gateway session to change chemical feed at WTP-A
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No per-session approval for the commissioning team; standing accounts
existing_controls: Gateway MFA; HMI entry limits (SI-10); hardwired stroke limits; staffed ROC
treatment_plan: Revoke exception (POAM-002); quarterly OT account certification (POAM-001); recording review (POAM-006)

threat_event: Attacker reaches an acquired system's HMI through a legacy vendor remote tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor tools and password-only VPNs at 19 systems
treatment_plan: Remove vendor tools; move behind SYS-G4 (POAM-013)
owner: Water Utility security and compliance lead

threat_event: Commissioning changes outside MOC put unsafe logic into WTP-A PLCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 40 sampled commissioning changes not in RS-1 MOC
existing_controls: Simulator testing; key switches in RUN
treatment_plan: All commissioning changes through RS-1 MOC (POAM-008)

threat_event: Shared HMI logins at acquired systems hide who changed a setpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared operator accounts
owner: Water Utility security and compliance lead

threat_event: Ransomware or logic tampering at an acquired system cannot be reversed quickly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No offline PLC logic or HMI project backups

threat_event: IT malware spreads into controllers on flat OT networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat networks; dual-homed historians at 7 acquired systems
treatment_plan: OT DMZ design per SP 800-82 Rev. 3 (POAM-017)
owner: Water Utility security and compliance lead

threat_event: Attack on a mid-size or acquired system goes unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT monitoring outside the 6 largest systems

threat_event: RRA reviews of 27 mid-size systems understate cyber risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generic checklist; no asset or vulnerability data
treatment_plan: Cyber addendum per system before ERP revision (POAM-024)

threat_event: Revised ERPs for 27 systems miss the 2026-12-24 certification date
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 27 ERPs in one quarter; addenda must come first

threat_event: Ransomware on the Water Utility business network disrupts CIS access, dispatch, and notices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Business network shared with plants' IT; offline contact exports monthly
existing_controls: EDR; immutable backups; offline contact lists
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests; notice capability from managed mobile devices
owner: Water Utility security and compliance lead

threat_event: End-of-support HMIs at WTP-C are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 HMIs cannot be patched

threat_event: Tier 1 notice is late after a cyber-caused treatment interruption
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public notice SOPs at many systems lack a cyber trigger; matrix not exercised
existing_controls: Tier 1 templates; offline contact lists at large systems
treatment_plan: Cyber trigger in all 58 PN SOPs (POAM-025); tabletop (POAM-004)
owner: Water Utility VP of Water Quality and Compliance

threat_event: Default RTU credentials let an attacker change tank or booster settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 RS-1 RTUs with vendor default credentials

threat_event: Intruder enters an unalarmed booster station
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 41 booster stations lack intrusion alarms
treatment_plan: Accepted until the 2027 capital program adds alarms
owner: Water Utility security and compliance lead

threat_event: AI-001 misses a real excursion or floods operators, and operators over-rely on it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Validation incomplete; operators instructed to act on alerts
existing_controls: SCADA and hardwired alarms remain the controls of record
owner: Water Utility VP of Water Quality and Compliance

threat_event: Exposed cellular modems at acquired systems are taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Modems with web administration reachable from the internet at 3 acquired systems
owner: Water Utility security and compliance lead

threat_event: The SCADA integrator's credentials are stolen and used
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator supports 14 regional systems
existing_controls: Integrator uses SYS-G4 with MFA; contract security terms (2024)

threat_event: Hurricane disables telemetry and power at remote sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Radio towers and remote sites exposed

threat_event: Customer data exposed through a CIS vendor breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1.21 million accounts at one vendor
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)
owner: Water Utility VP of Customer Service

threat_event: Phishing compromises Water Utility staff accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field and office staff on shared devices
treatment_plan: Number matching on all field devices
owner: Water Utility security and compliance lead

threat_event: Operators respond wrongly to unexplained HMI behavior
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT role training at 71% of RS-1 operators

threat_event: Historian data loss breaks compliance records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Replica and redundant servers exist
treatment_plan: Annual restore test of historian data

threat_event: Fire or flood takes out the ROC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup control room at WTP-B
treatment_plan: Accepted; failover tested twice a year

threat_event: Engineering workstation local admin rights are misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All engineer accounts are local administrators at WTP-A

threat_event: RRA, ERP, or SCADA diagrams are disclosed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Documents in shared repositories

threat_event: OT emergency account passwords stay valid after use
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rotation after break-glass use

threat_event: Mass-notification vendor fails during an emergency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single vendor
treatment_plan: Pre-arranged media and door-hanger plans in each ERP
owner: Water Utility VP of Water Quality and Compliance

threat_event: Small systems outside section 1433 lack cyber emergency procedures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 16 systems of 3,300 or fewer have no RRA or ERP duty
treatment_plan: One-page cyber annex per small system
